description: Defines the IOBuffer class and its variants used for asynchronous IO operations in the net namespace, including reference counting, ownership semantics, and various buffer types.

classes.name: IOBuffer
classes.description: Reference counted data buffer for asynchronous IO, managing ownership and lifetime of the underlying char* buffer.

classes.name: IOBufferWithSize
classes.description: Extends IOBuffer to include size information.

classes.name: StringIOBuffer
classes.description: Read-only IOBuffer backed by a std::string.

classes.name: DrainableIOBuffer
classes.description: Buffer that supports progressive reading and consumption of data.

classes.name: GrowableIOBuffer
classes.description: Resizable buffer for reading data without knowing total size upfront.

classes.name: PickledIOBuffer
classes.description: Uses a base::Pickle as storage to avoid data copying.

classes.name: WrappedIOBuffer
classes.description: Temporary IOBuffer that does not own the underlying buffer.

methods.name: IOBuffer(size_t buffer_size)
methods.description: Creates an IOBuffer with specified size.

methods.name: data()
methods.description: Returns pointer to the buffer data.

methods.name: StringIOBuffer(const std::string& s)
methods.description: Creates a read-only buffer from a string.

methods.name: StringIOBuffer(std::unique_ptr<std::string> s)
methods.description: Creates a read-only buffer from a unique_ptr to string.

methods.name: DrainableIOBuffer(scoped_refptr<IOBuffer> base, int/size_t size)
methods.description: Constructs a drainable buffer from an existing IOBuffer.

methods.name: DidConsume(int bytes)
methods.description: Marks bytes as consumed, adjusting internal pointer.

methods.name: SetOffset(int bytes)
methods.description: Sets the current offset in the buffer.

methods.name: StartOfBuffer()
methods.description: Returns pointer to start of buffer.

methods.name: Done()
methods.description: Marks pickle as ready for IO operation.

methods.name: WrappedIOBuffer(const char* data)
methods.description: Creates a temporary buffer referencing existing data.
